item.title: Gavin Newsom’s autobiography adds struggle to a story of a politically privileged past
item.description: Gavin Newsom follows previous Democratic presidential hopefuls by publishing a campaign book implying he didn't have everything handed to him.

item.title: Republican Steve Hilton leads California governor fundraising as large pool of Democrats lag
item.description: It takes tens of millions of dollars to run a statewide campaign for governor. Strategists say the many Democratic candidates aren’t raising money quickly enough.

item.title: Newsom blasts Trump administration’s immigration crackdown; touts California’s drug enforcement efforts
item.description: At a San Diego press conference, Gov. Gavin Newsom highlighted California’s drug enforcement efforts, while criticizing President Trump’s immigration crackdowns.

item.title: California judges defend their independence and the rule of law
item.description: President Trump, Gov. Newsom and other politicians pressured judges. But judges say they can’t bow to political or popular will, only to the law.

item.title: These California trucking schools broke state laws. Regulators couldn’t do anything about it
item.description: A loophole in state law allows trucking schools to operate with little state oversight, raising concerns about the quality of training for California’s truck drivers.

item.title: Some California high-speed rail records could remain secret under proposed law
item.description: California created an inspector general to monitor its long-delayed high-speed rail project. Now, one lawmaker wants to allow that office to withhold some investigative records from the public.

item.title: How much training does the driver of that truck next to you have?
item.description: With roughly 1.8 million commercial trucks on California roads, chances are high that you’ll encounter one on your next drive. But despite the heightened dangers that come with such colossal vehicles, over a hundred unlicensed schools operate in California with little to no oversight. item.title: Licenciaturas en colegios comunitarios: los legisladores dicen que sí pero UC y CSU piden frenar el paso
item.description: El último proyecto de ley permitiría a Southwestern College crear hasta cuatro programas de licenciatura adicionales destinados a cubrir las necesidades de la fuerza laboral en el sur del condado de San Diego.

item.title: Maestros de San Diego planean su primera huelga en 30 años por problemas con el personal y los servicios de educación especial
item.description: Los maestros de San Diego planean su primera huelga en 30 años el 26 de febrero, acusando al distrito de no cumplir con los estándares de personal de educación especial y de no brindar servicios a los estudiantes con discapacidades.

item.title: California’s instant EV rebates would require automakers to match state funds
item.description: New budget language lays out how Gov. Gavin Newsom plans to structure a $200 million electric vehicle rebate program, including price caps, automaker matching funds and a focus on first-time buyers.
